candidates.content_angle: Explains what Vietnamese law expects from pedestrians: walking on the pavement, verge or pedestrian path, or close to the right-hand edge of the road where there is none (Article 30(1)(a) of Law 36/2024/QH15); crossing only at traffic lights, marked crossings, footbridges or underpasses and following their signals, or, where none exists, only after watching the oncoming vehicles and with a hand signal (Article 30(1)(b)); no climbing over medians or holding on to moving vehicles (Article 30(1)(c)); children under 7 crossing with an adult (Article 30(2)(a)); the pedestrian fines in Article 10 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP (VND 150,000-250,000 for walking outside the permitted part of the road, crossing at the wrong place or without a hand signal, or ignoring lights, signs, markings or traffic officers; VND 400,000-600,000 for entering an expressway, carrying bulky items that obstruct traffic or holding on to a moving vehicle); and practical crossing technique in dense motorbike traffic.

distinct_from.reason: FR-S62 explique quand le conducteur d'un scooter doit s'arrêter au passage piéton. Ce sujet explique les règles propres aux piétons : où marcher, où et comment traverser, et les amendes des piétons.
FR-S12 explique comment circuler en scooter dans le trafic de Hanoï. Ce sujet explique comment s'y déplacer à pied.
FR-S48 explique les feux de circulation pour les conducteurs de scooter. Ce sujet traite des feux et des signaux que doivent suivre les piétons.
